title: MC Redux
description: A refined Vanilla+ experience with stunning visuals, expanded exploration, and no shaders required.
body:
![modpack logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65d1aefd0575a3c8730df15fabb00c98ff36b44e_0.webp)

 **Minecraft Redux** is a Vanilla+ modpack focused on improving Minecraft's visuals, atmosphere, exploration, and gameplay while staying true to the original experience.

Explore breathtaking landscapes, enhanced biomes, expanded dimensions, immersive animations, and carefully selected quality-of-life features that make the game feel fresh without losing its vanilla identity.

### Features

* Beautiful visuals without shaders ([Shine](https://modrinth.com/mod/shine)) 
* Enhanced lighting and atmosphere
* Expanded Nether and End
* New structures to discover
* Improved oceans and deserts
* Fresh mob and player animations
* Refined combat feedback
* Vanilla-friendly progression
* Optimized for smooth gameplay

### Minecraft Redux proves that Minecraft can be beautiful even without shaders.
